title: Measuring and Improving Model-Moderator Collaboration using Uncertainty Estimation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity classification models on highly skewed datasets and applying Focal Loss as a debiasing technique to mitigate the model's tendency to bias predictions toward the majority (non-toxic) class.

Measuring the drop in predictive and calibration performance (distributional shift) when models trained on Wikipedia discussion comments are deployed on an out-of-domain dataset of news site comments, highlighting the models' over-reliance on spurious lexical or dialectal cues from the training data.
